section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1975
title: Accidental Deaths Sex-Wise The percentage of male victims from amongst the total accidental deaths reported during 1975, for the country as a whole was much more than for the female victims. The percentage of male victims was 66.4 per cent and for the female victims it was 33.6 per cent. The ratio of male and female victims was 66.1 per cent & 33.9 per cent, respectively for the States, 75.9 per cent & 24.1 per cent, respectively for the Union Territories and 67.6 per cent & 32.4 per cent, respectively for the Metropolitan cities. In Lakshadweep and Nagaland the percentage of male involvement was the maximum i.e., 100.0 per cent and 97.1 per cent, respectively. The States where male involvement in the ‘accidental deaths’ was above 70 per cent numbered ten; in Union Territories this number was seven and in Metropolitan Cities this number was two. The detailed statistics may be seen in Table V. TABLE V Region-wise distribution of Accidental Deaths by Sex, 1975
